messages:
maya: Quick pass on the new dark console theme (shadow-ink). Dropping palette and some screenshots. Mainly worried about small-chart legibility and code syntax contrast. Thoughts? :eyes:

maya: palette vars:
```
--bg: #0b0f14
--surface: #0f1724
--surface-weak: #131a26
--muted: #94a3b8
--accent: #7dd3fc
--accent-2: #60a5fa
--error: #fb7185
--success: #86efac
--spark: linear-gradient(90deg, #0ea5a4 0%, #60a5fa 100%)
```

maya: problem: sparklines at 1px on small cards disappear against --surface-weak. contrast between code-bg and token colors also low.

tom: Agree re sparklines. Can we try boosting the sparkline color or add a 1px glow? Also numbers in charts use #94a3b8 which computes ~3.2:1 on --surface; we should aim for >=4.5:1 for body numbers. Suggest #cbd5e1 or #d1d9e6 for labels.

eva: +1 on increasing contrast. For the code panel: line numbers are currently #374151 on --surface; that's too faint when you're scanning diffs. Recommend #9ca3af for line numbers and keep keywords at --accent. Strings should be warmer (#86efac looks fine).

liam: For token heatmap, high density reds lose punch in dark because of perceptual clipping. Recommend using slightly desaturated mid-range colors and reserve full saturation for the top 10% so hotspots pop without washing out gradients.

design-bot: Accessibility check: contrast fails for --muted (#94a3b8) on --surface (#0f1724) = 3.1:1 (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text).

maya: Proposed tweaks:
```
--muted: #c7d2e7  /* bump for labels */
--code-bg: rgba(12,16,20,0.6) /* subtle separation without full card */
--keyword: #60a5fa
--string: #86efac
--number: #fca5a5
```

maya: also thinking about chart axis lines: thin vs slightly thicker. If we go from 1px -> 1.5px will that break visual rhythm for lists of small cards? @tom @eva ?

tom: Thicker axes are fine for metrics cards. For tiny sparklines I'd rather keep hairline axis but add a faint top/bottom glow around the sparkline: `box-shadow: 0 0 4px rgba(96,165,250,0.12)` so the line reads at various opacities. Keep CSS performant (no heavy filters).

eva: Copy nit: In Settings -> Theme toggle, change label from 'Console theme' -> 'Appearance' and add secondary text 'Auto (system)'. Also add a 'Reduce motion' toggle as an accessibility setting. :a11y:

liam: Chart legend ordering: neutral -> accent -> error left-to-right so it matches reading order for most dashboards. Tooltip contrast: use tooltip bg #0b1220 with text #e6eef9 (this hits ~12:1).

maya: I'll run a quick A/B with current vs the tweaked palette and capture contrast numbers + a11y report. Planning to land variant B this afternoon unless objections. :shipit:
